_source: Built mechanically from the facts of CBP ruling N359690 (2026-04-13, held-out Part 102 window final; subject: ""). Frozen by the D570 rule before any run. CBP held Canada. Components: the D362 materials; part codes: the top D381 held-out suggestion (unverified, D382); the good's code: CBP's (8415.20.0000). Family and name: the family check (vehicle_parts, 0.85); name from the subject (D381 rule). Materials with no country left out (14: base frame, H block, fan, mounting plate, fittings for the compressor, refrigerant lines, vibration mounts, temperature sensors, harnesses for the heater and condenser, converter sub-assembly, input/output connectors, main electrical harness, fuse door, top cover). Groups: one model call with the production extractor's group rule (groups.jsonl). Plants one per country; operations one per group and plant plus final assembly in Canada. Target China by the D171 rule counted mechanically; plant capabilities for China are an assumption. Economics illustrative. D570.
